name: Playwright 13-Language Visual UI Overflow Scan
greenMarker: No text overflow, orphan lines, or card bloat detected
note: What this gate does NOT see: any element that clips with text-overflow: ellipsis. The home banner cards all set white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis, so a long title there is truncated by design and is deliberately not reported. Aim mutations at elements that have no such clipping — .mode-tab-btn, .badge, .nav-item span — or the gate will pass and be right to.

mutations.name: a German mode tab grows into an unbreakable compound
mutations.why: German compounds are how this class of bug arrives. The three mode tabs share one row with 2px of horizontal padding each, so a word wider than a third of the screen pushes the layout past the phone edge.
mutations.history: Three earlier attempts all passed, and all three were right to: a brand-new key that nothing renders, home.modes.academy.title which the home screen does not use, and home.modes.battle.title which sits in an ellipsis-clipped card. A fourth run reached the right element but named the wrong message: the gate reports "LAYOUT DEFECTS DETECTED", not the word overflow.
